To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Logistic Model Tree is the best performing model for gully erosion mapping.
the LMT model, among the three we tested, produces the best susceptibility map for the Bastam watershed.

(1) The LMT model is the best choice to map gully susceptibility; (2) The LMT is also the only model which provides reasonable mapping results; (3) The LMT provides the highest predictive power among all models; and, (4) The Index of Entropy is a good indicator of the environmental factors affecting gully erosion in the study watershed.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a machine learning based gully erosion model which is capable of predicting the phenomenon in space and which is also associated with reasonable and interpretable susceptibility mapping patterns.

a novel approach to the gully erosion susceptibility modeling which, in addition to a novel machine learning model, provides a novel interpretation of environmental preconditioning causes and a novel approach for the gully erosion modeling.
a novel application of machine learning algorithms for the susceptibility mapping of gully erosion in a mountainous area.
